question: In the CAFA Nations Cup 2025, which team did India defeat to secure the bronze medal in football at Hisor Central Stadium, Tajikistan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Oman.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **India defeated Oman 3–2 on penalties after a 1–1 draw in regulation time to claim the bronze medal in the CAFA Nations Cup 2025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **This was the first-ever victory for India over Oman in an international football match.**
 
• **Udanta Singh scored the equaliser in regulation time to take the match to penalties.**
 
• **Gurpreet Singh Sandhu saved the final penalty, securing India’s historic win.**
 
• **The final score in the penalty shootout was 3–2 in India’s favour.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Venue:** Hisor Central Stadium, Tajikistan
 
• **Event:** CAFA Nations Cup 2025
 
• **India’s Historic Finish:** Bronze medal, marking a significant achievement in Indian football history.
